30294.context: Moreover, if we believe as I do, that God's grace is extended to those who die in infancy or as small children, the death of these children was actually their salvation. We are so wedded to an earthly naturalistic perspective that we forget that those who die are happy to quit this earth for heaven's incomparable joy, therefore God does these children no wrong in taking their lives.

claims.text: The speaker suggests that extending grace is essential for collective human development and coexistence in the modern world (L7, L16).
It functions as a means of self-correction or compassion, particularly when the speaker acknowledges being harder on themselves than others (L3).
